name: @quaestor-ledger/pub-lib-core-workspace
description: Verification workspace for Quaestor's public, transport-neutral client primitives.

scripts.check: node scripts/generate-typespec.mjs --check && node scripts/authority-agreement.mjs --check && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/public-boundary cargo run --quiet --locked --manifest-path tools/public-boundary/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:rust: cargo fmt --check && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/public-core cargo test --locked && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/public-core cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.test:dart: cd dart && dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test && dart analyze && dart run test/conformance.dart
scripts.test:boundary: cargo fmt --manifest-path tools/public-boundary/Cargo.toml --check && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/public-boundary cargo test --locked --manifest-path tools/public-boundary/Cargo.toml && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/public-boundary cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path tools/public-boundary/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:typescript && npm run test:rust && npm run test:dart && npm run test:boundary && npm run check
